paragraphs: Sheila Mari. Rav Shmuel bar Yehudah said, and likewise Shili Mari taught: Shabbat 43b. Rav Kahana said; some say Sheila Mari: there, 32b. Kahana said [Rav in the checked Bavli]; some say Sheila bar Mari: Gittin 58a. The word bar is a scribal error.
